base.note: The Código Penal as printed in the Ministry of Justice's twelfth official edition (Décimo Segunda Edición Oficial, May 2016), which states it is current to 31 May 2016. Earlier history is not rebuilt here: this is the oldest version available in this history. The edition's footnotes (amendment notes and earlier wording) are not part of the text. Article 401-C, which the edition already prints, is left out: Ley 30424 added it with effect from 1 January 2018.

drop.art-401-c: The edition prints art. 401-C, added by Ley 30424 (published 21 April 2016), whose own Primera Disposición Complementaria Final put it in force on 1 July 2017, moved to 1 January 2018 by Decreto Legislativo 1352; the article is absent before that day and arrives on 1 January 2018 credited to Ley 30424.
